# Subway Seat for Ghostty

The 16 ANSI colors, cursor, selection and split fill. For light/dark following, use `theme = light:Subway Seat Enamel,dark:Subway Seat`.

[Ghostty](https://ghostty.org) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/ghostty/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`Subway Seat`](Subway%20Seat) | `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`Subway Seat Tunnel`](Subway%20Seat%20Tunnel) | `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`Subway Seat Enamel`](Subway%20Seat%20Enamel) | `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Enamel` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config:

```conf
theme = Subway Seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config:

```conf
theme = Subway Seat Tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/ghostty/config:

```conf
theme = Subway Seat Enamel
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Tunnel`.
- Delete `~/.config/ghostty/themes/Subway Seat Enamel`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
